name: 59714 · Belgrade, MT
findings: ZIP 59714 (Belgrade) has 64 nonprofit organizations. 22 of them (34%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 18 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (38% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 59714 (Belgrade) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
27% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 59714 (Belgrade) list public events in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 40% of the typical level).
